title: 📱 ChatGPT changes on your phone... a dedicated tab for your AI agent and pinning for your favorite tools!
body: 📱 ChatGPT changes on your phone... a dedicated tab for your AI agent and pinning for your favorite tools!

OpenAI has begun rolling out a new design for the ChatGPT app on phones, splitting the app's interface into three sections in a bottom bar, to make it easier to reach the many features that have accumulated in the app.

The first section, called 'Home', keeps the familiar chat interface, while the second section, called 'Dots', opens a direct conversation with your permanent AI agent, which works in the background and continues your tasks between conversations.
The third section gathers the rest of the app's tools in a single grid, including Codex for programming, Images, Projects, Add-ons, Space, Finance, Sites, Health and Scheduled Tasks.
You can also pin your most-used tools to the bottom bar, by long-pressing any tool and choosing 'Pin to tab bar', and replacing one shortcut with another or removing it if the bar gets full.

The new design reaches first Pro subscribers aged 18 and over in the regions where Dots is available, along with a limited group of Plus subscribers, and does not include the European Economic Area, Britain, Switzerland and South Korea in the first stage, nor does it support the iPhone SE, iPhone Duo and iPad, and you can return to the old design from the settings.
Simply put: the chat app has become a home screen for AI tools... would you prefer your agent in a dedicated tab or inside the conversation itself?
Which tool would you pin first in the bottom bar if the new design reached you?
